_schema_note: Every value the docs actually decide, verbatim or as DEFAULT-flagged. Undecided values are null or 'TBD' — nothing invented. Currency names follow the locked Sept 26 nomenclature (Crowns/coins); the docs' older names are mapped in '_stale_name_mapping'.
_tbd: Coin-bundle prices (Crown ladder fully locked Sep 27, 2026)
Premium season pass: duration and reward track
Whale starter pack: exact Crown amount and item list
Atelier 2x/4x/8x energy multipliers: amounts, unlock rules, Crown costs
Whether duplicate-offer/jewel-shelf Crown prices (5x tier; 120/200/90) are launch values or DEFAULT placeholders

coins.role: soft currency: storyline advancement (story scenes, chapter turns, selected estate progress) prices in coins, never Crowns
sinks: dressing-ritual components: 5 coins per component (75 per full 15-step ritual); re-picks within a session are free
story scenes: 120-290 coins per scene, scaling across the season (locked Sep 27, 2026)
sources: order fulfillment: story commissions pay round(2 x requestedTier x 3.0); custom orders pay round(2 x requestedTier x 1.0); rarity multiplier 1.0-2.0 for spawner-sourced items
half-coin merge: 2 half-coins merge to 1 coin (fractional balances allowed internally, displayed floored)
Modiste's Exchange: Common->2, Fine->5, Rare->12, Ultra-Rare->30 coins (+1 favor kickback on duplicate ultra-rare)
Daily Vote verdict: T1=5, T2=10, T3=15, T4=25, T5=40 coins
event-currency leftover conversion at event end: 10:1 (rounded down)

free_sources: random merge spawn: 2% per merge, cap 5 uncollected on board
Daily Vote verdict: T2=1, T3=2, T4=3, T5=5 (T1=0)
crowns.role: premium currency: energy, targeted items, fashion, energy, attempts; never score/rank/verdict

sinks.price: +10 slots for 50 (beyond 10 free; up to 50 paid slots)
10 per skip, max 3 skips per event

boost_drops.note: lost if pool is at cap

energy.judging_reward: +3 atelier energy per judgment, max 20 judgments/day
energy.park_merge_reward: DEFAULT: 60% chance +3 park energy, 40% chance +2 coins
energy.refill_ladder_reset: price returns to 15 when 24h have passed since last refill purchase (rolling window, per pool)
energy.regen_rate: LOCKED Sep 27, 2026 (Beth): 1 energy per 3 minutes; regen cap 200; purchased energy may exceed cap

estate_funds.note: no timer on restoration, ever; required merge products tiers 4-8 escalating by zone
estate_funds.role: Hartwell Park restoration only; ledger-enforced, never leaves the Park

earn: judging Daily Vote entries: 2 event-progress points per judgment, converts 1:1 to live event currency
event_currencies.namespace: event:<eventId>; earned and spent only inside that event
event_currencies.settlement: leftovers auto-convert to coins at 10:1 (rounded down) at event end, notified via inbox; incomplete plaque progress carries to the event's next rerun
event_currencies.shop: 6 items per event (energy boosts, board items, rarely a premium Fashion Plate)

favors._name_status: LOCKED Sep 27, 2026 (Beth): Favors (gemstone names reserved for side games)

draw.pity: guaranteed Rare-or-better every 20 draws, guaranteed Ultra-Rare every 80 draws

favors.role: card currency; earned only, never bought (no SKU, no purchase path)

event_pass.cadence: weekly events run Monday 00:00 UTC -> Sunday 23:59 UTC
event_pass.plaque_sets: 8 plaques x 5 levels per event; task drops weighted L1 50% / L2 30% / L3 20%; levels 4-5 by merging duplicate plaques; set completion pays a board generator (treasure chest / jewelry box / steamer trunk)
event_pass.price: $4.99 base escalating to $49.99 with play (locked Sep 27, 2026)
event_pass.rule: daily engagement unlocks escalating rewards and event-exclusive options; every fashion reward keeps a credible earned route or published return cadence
event_pass.tasks: 8 escalating tasks per event; every task pays event currency + a plaque drop

paywall_audit: free player (zero IAP, average luck) must clear all 30 chapters, all closet collections, all 7 Park zones, and one full event; build fails otherwise
purse_moment: one per level = the jewel-shelf premium spend only; commission lines relabeled 'Preparation ritual (fashion currency, merge-earned)'

time_only_rewards.definition: rewards earned exclusively through time and consistency; no purchase can substitute at any price
time_only_rewards.items: Triumph Gown (all 30 S1 chapters), season-completion keepsakes, perfect-season mementos (locked Sep 27, 2026)

whale_starter_pack.contents: Crowns + exclusive outfit + energy refills (locked Sep 27, 2026)
whale_starter_pack.shape: bounded: enough to reach the first major social payoff and sample the full fashion-Vote-Gazette loop across 3-5 high-engagement sessions; must NOT finish a timed pass, bankroll recurring Vote dominance, or bypass the next replenishment decision
